'''Ellis''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] serving the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Ellis was in charge of intercepting enemy communications for the entire [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]]. During the [[Second Battle of Fondor]], Ellis [[Death/Legends|died]] aboard the [[Turbulent-class Star Destroyer|''Turbulent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']] when the crew of the ''Bloodfin'' mutinied against the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], who decided to side with [[Darth Caedus]] after [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] death.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex" />
